newsitem.title: USA: Maine legislative committee weighs crime bills.
newsitem.headline: Maine legislative committee weighs crime bills.

text.p: NEW YORK, Jan 20 (Reuter) The Maine legislature's Criminal Justice Committee will weigh two measures to force criminals to pay for their crimes with more than just jail time.
Representative Edgar Wheeler of (R-Bridgewater) wants to see state prisoners forced to fork over 25-percent of their income to support their families.
And Representative Michael McAlevey (R-Waterboro) would increase a fee some inmates now pay to help defray the cost of housing them.
The Department of Corrections supports Wheeler's bill, while McAlevey said he is making his proposal on behalf of county prosecutors.
